title: Board-Approved Activity Fee Catalogue of Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
These are the catalogue amounts of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** for each activity type of Calloway Creek ISD, in US dollars: the participation fee and the period it covers, the overnight travel fee, the student-kept uniform package and whether meal-status fee waivers reduce it, the two parts of a trip fee, and the late registration fee with the deadline that makes a registration late.

## Participation, travel and uniform amounts

| Activity type | Participation fee | Period one participation fee covers | Travel fee per participation | Uniform package | Uniform package reduced by meal-status fee waivers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | 15.00 | per activity per school year | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | 35.00 | per activity per school year | 95.00 | 0.00 | yes |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | 40.00 | per activity per season | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | 60.00 | per activity per school year | 145.00 | 0.00 | yes |
| High School UIL Athletics | 85.00 | per activity per season | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes |
| Cheer and Dance Team | 85.00 | per activity per school year | 0.00 | 425.00 | no |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | 0.00 | per trip | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes |

The travel fee is the overnight competition or performance travel fee per participation, 0.00 where the type has none. The uniform package is apparel the student keeps, charged per participation, 0.00 where the type has none.

## Trip fee

| Activity type | Trip deposit posted at registration | Trip balance fee posted on the trip balance posting date |
|---|---|---|
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | 50.00 | 135.00 |
| every other type | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The trip deposit and the trip balance are the two portions of the one trip fee: 50.00 and 135.00 together make a trip fee of 185.00.

## Late registration

| Activity type | Late registration fee | Days before the first practice or event date after which a registration is late |
|---|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | 15.00 | 14 |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | 15.00 | 14 |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | 15.00 | 14 |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | 15.00 | 14 |
| High School UIL Athletics | 15.00 | 14 |
| Cheer and Dance Team | 15.00 | 14 |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | 15.00 | 14 |

## Reading the catalogue

- A participation fee charged per activity per season is charged once for each season the student registers; one charged per activity per school year covers the whole school year of that activity; the trip fee is per trip.
- A 0.00 amount in this catalogue means the type carries no such component.
- The uniform package of the Cheer and Dance Team, 425.00, is the one package in this catalogue that meal-status fee waivers do not reduce.
